svg.title: Inspect a shared mistake followed by its revert in VS Code
svg.desc: 1: The new revert is a separate commit at the top of Graph. 2: The original shared mistake remains in the recorded history. 3: The log shows local and practice remote branches at the new revert. 4: Check the README still records the corrected angle units.
